controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.objective: MFA is enforced for remote access, administrative accounts, and email.

evidence.description: Identity provider MFA policy and enrollment report

questions.text: Percentage of user accounts enrolled in and required to use MFA
Is MFA enforced for all remote access and all administrative accounts with no standing exceptions?
questions.guidance: Partial: exceptions exist with documented approval.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Least privilege and access review
controls.objective: Access rights follow least privilege and are reviewed at least every 6 months.

questions.text: Was a review of user and privileged access rights completed in the last 6 months, with removals recorded?
questions.guidance: Partial: review done for some systems only.

questions.text: Number of accounts with domain or global administrator rights
questions.guidance: Count from the directory. Compare with the number of people whose roles require it.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Patch management
controls.objective: Security patches are applied within defined times by severity.

questions.text: Median days to deploy critical security patches over the last 3 months
Percentage of endpoints and servers running an operating system version with vendor support
questions.guidance: Compare inventory versions with vendor lifecycle.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Secure configuration and application control
controls.objective: Systems are built from hardened baselines and unauthorized software is blocked.

questions.text: Are servers and endpoints built from a documented hardened baseline with drift monitored?
questions.guidance: Partial: baseline exists but drift not monitored.

questions.text: Is installation or execution of unapproved software blocked on endpoints (application allowlisting or no local admin rights)?
questions.guidance: Test with a standard user account if allowed.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Network segmentation
controls.objective: Networks are segmented so that critical systems, OT, and security devices are separated from general user networks.

questions.text: Are critical servers, operational technology, and building security systems on segments separated from user networks with deny-by-default rules?
questions.guidance: Partial: segmented but with any-any rules between segments.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Cybersecurity awareness training
controls.objective: Staff complete security awareness training, and specialized roles receive role training, at least every 12 months.

evidence.description: Training completion and phishing simulation reports

questions.text: Percentage of staff completing cybersecurity awareness training in the last 12 months
Have administrators and developers completed role-specific security training in the last 12 months?

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29

controls.title: Server room environmental protection
controls.objective: Technology rooms are protected against fire, water, heat, and power loss.

evidence.description: Photo of environmental controls and hazards

questions.text: Does the main technology room have fire detection, temperature and water monitoring with alerts, and UPS power?
questions.guidance: Partial: one control missing. Photograph water pipes above equipment or missing controls.

questions.text: Highest temperature reading in the technology room at the time of inspection
questions.guidance: Read from the room monitor or a handheld thermometer at rack inlet height.

references.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
references.note: wording to be checked against CSWP 29
